about: What plan 7D Task 0 recorded about Claude Code 2.1.321 started under fin-sandbox-exec on Linux (Landlock enforced, no namespaces, 2026-11-13; raw logs in the maintainer's archive/). `deniedReads` are the reads the `agent` profile refused during that start, a trailing `/*` means every file below the directory (the names were not kept); `install` is the layout of the CLI's install tree. Home is written <home>. toolchain_list_is_minimal (tests/toolchain_claude.rs) holds data/linux/toolchain-claudeCode.txt to this file: every entry is a recorded read (a `<dir>/*` record is its directory; an ancestor of one is too broad), and a recorded read is either covered or named under `tolerated` with the reason it is not granted.

tolerated./proc/self/statm: a per-process link: no Landlock root can name it (roots are opened without following links)
tolerated./etc/machine-id: a host identifier; the CLI carries on without it
tolerated.<home>/.gitconfig: the user's git configuration; the session's own is GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL

install.note: one file; a newer version is a new file beside it, so the readable directory is the target's parent
